name: shisa-v2.1-lfm2-1.2b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.17 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2025-11-13. CAVEAT: this is a single row, on Shisa's OWN newly-introduced CLTL benchmark (cross-lingual token leakage), which is a metric their fine-tuning explicitly targets - in-domain by construction, and no independent replication exists. The card's Japanese/English MultiEval tables compare Shisa siblings against each other and print no LFM2-1.2B column, so no capability claim against the base survives from this card; the sibling shisa-v2.1-qwen3-8b shows the same leakage pattern, which suggests a house training recipe rather than a property of this checkpoint. Treat the 13.5x number as evidence of the recipe, not of general ability. FLOPs per active token set to 2.34e+09 (= 2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) rather than the generator's 6e9 coefficient, which is a 3x overstatement still live in tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251; value overwritten from base record lfm2-1-2b.

benchmarks.name: CLTL Japanese cross-lingual token leakage
benchmarks.config: Card CLTL table, Shisa V2.1's own leakage benchmark; base LFM2-1.2B 4.32% (13.5x reduction). Lower is better. Single row is the only base comparison the card prints.
